{

  "features": [
    {
      "name": "root_shoot_dry_weight_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of average dry weight of root to average dry weight of vegetative plants, capturing root-to-shoot biomass allocation balance",
      "value_range": [0.07, 14.6],
      "feature_family": "biomass_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear separability between growth treatment groups through biomass partitioning differences",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ADWR / (ADWV + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_chlorophyll_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized chlorophyll content using training-set mean and std, providing a smooth centered score for linear margins",
      "value_range": [-1.2, 1.9],
      "feature_family": "normalized_physiology",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Centered continuous feature improves SVM margin geometry for chlorophyll-driven separations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(ACHP - 38.069) / 4.444"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_water_content_index",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "AWWR / (ADWR + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vegetative_water_content_index",

      "feature_family": "water_content",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous hydration measure for vegetative tissue enabling linear discrimination between treatment conditions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "AWWGV / (ADWV + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "leaf_area_per_leaf_count",

      "description": "Average leaf area divided by average number of leaves, representing individual leaf size efficiency",

      "formula": "ALAP / (ANPL + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "root_aspect_ratio",

      "feature_family": "root_morphology",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "ARL / (ARD + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "composite_growth_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of normalized PHR, ALAP, and ANPL capturing overall vegetative growth vigor",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "composite_growth",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.4 * ((PHR - 58.996) / 11.998) + 0.35 * ((ALAP - 1063.991) / 260.435) + 0.25 * ((ANPL - 3.941) / 0.700)"

    {
      "name": "dry_matter_imbalance",

    {
      "name": "log_root_biomass_density",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,

    }
  ]
